title: Procedure
description: One civic task a citizen can complete, e.g. 'Register a shop under Shops & Establishments Act'. Made of many Steps (see step.schema.json).

taskKeywords.description: Lowercased keywords/synonyms the matcher checks against free-text task input, e.g. ['shop registration', 'gumasta', 'open a shop', 'register my store']

state.description: e.g. 'Maharashtra'. Use 'all' if nationally applicable (e.g. PAN).

applicantType.description: Which entity types this procedure applies to; null/['any'] if it applies to everyone

sourceId.description: _id reference into sources.json — the primary official source for this procedure

status.description: Overall curation status. Must not be 'verified' unless every required field on every step is confirmed against the official source.

notes.description: Free-text curator notes, e.g. 'Fee schedule not published online — confirm by phone with MCGM ward office'
